answer: Canary honeypot audit with probation: every cycle the network plants graded honeypot challenges and a lantern scanner sweeps a random canyon of identities, 8% per round, unannounced. A key caught feeding a honeypot loses its violet bond — 35% of expected earnings, locked, non-transferable and non-poolable across keys — and enters a 30-day probation queue before re-bonding. Honest agents pay one stake once; a sybil farm of 40 keys pays 40 separate bonds plus 40x audit exposure, super-linear against collusion.
